record.what_it_does: Ecommerce-focused customer support helpdesk with tickets, macros, rules and AI agent.
record.auth_notes: Private apps use account email plus API key (HTTP basic). Public apps must use OAuth2, with scopes. A multi-user toolkit would use OAuth2.
record.access_notes: A private app with an API key works on any Gorgias account. I didn't find a free tier or trial terms. Public OAuth2 apps need app review before listing in the App Store. Submissions must include a test account. I couldn't confirm whether OAuth2 works for unreviewed apps in dev mode.
record.api_breadth_notes: REST endpoints grouped by resource: Tickets, Customers, Macros, Rules, Views, Tags, Teams, Users, Voice Calls, Widgets and more. I didn't count operations.
record.mcp_notes: https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp. Open beta, OAuth through the browser, one Gorgias account per connection. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and others. Some writes are gated during the beta.
record.blocker_notes: Distributing to other users needs OAuth2 and Gorgias app review. Developer credentials need a Gorgias account, whose cost I didn't confirm. The official MCP server is in beta with some writes gated.

evidence.quote: Using OAuth2 is mandatory for public apps.
Any plan works. AI Agent is not required.
The Gorgias API is structured with REST in mind.
building a public app (including app review)

record.needs_human: Check whether a free trial or dev account gives API access. Check whether OAuth2 apps work before review. Check whether an OpenAPI spec is published. Check whether a sandbox exists. Webhooks are inferred from search snippets about HTTP integrations, and I couldn't open the dev-portal webhook page, which returned 404.
